disclaimers: Self-reported communication needs, written by the person and held by them.
Not PIP evidence and does not replace any assessment. No descriptor scoring.
Not endorsed by DWP or the Timms Review. Not an official 'Tell Us Once' profile.
Not a medical or clinical document. OpenHear is a research platform for environmental sound awareness; it is not a hearing aid or a medical device.
Written to local files only. No upload, no account, no central storage.
Contains no hearing test results, diagnosis or identifier, and is not a digital ID.
The optional SHA-256 value is an integrity hash, not a signature.

consent.statement: I have previewed this summary and I chose which sections it includes. It is written to local files on my device only. Nothing is uploaded. It is my own document, not a digital ID.

reasonable_adjustments.description: Please contact me by email only. Email is a reasonable adjustment for me, not a preference.
For any live spoken meeting or assessment, please provide live speech-to-text, such as a palantypist or real-time captions.
Please send written questions or an agenda in advance where possible.

channels_that_do_not_work_for_me.in_my_own_words: I cannot follow speech on the phone, so I miss what is said.

functional_impact.in_my_own_words: Without text access to speech I cannot reliably follow spoken conversation. With live captions I can take part. Background noise and several people talking at once make it much harder. I can deal with my own affairs in writing.
what_does_not_help: Being asked to repeat everything at each new contact

variation_over_time.in_my_own_words: On tired days following even captioned conversation takes longer and I need more breaks.
In unfamiliar or busy rooms I miss more side-comments, even when the main speaker is captioned.

clinician_sourced.note: Not included. The minimal version carries self-reported content only.
